entries.english:

Date range: 1894

Contains: Format: photograph

Persons and institutions involved in its creation: Kempke, E., photographer

Image support: photographic paper mounted on cardboard

Image and sheet dimensions: 22 × 14.5 cm; 32 × 24 cm

Remarks: From the estate of Gustav Freiherr von Starkloff, General of Cavalry, killed in action; only two of the people depicted are identified by name
